signal: Prove launched ProveX, a new digital trust exchange, in Dec 2025 alongside its Unified Authentication platform

email.body1:
Joon, saw Prove launched ProveX, your new digital trust exchange, on top of Unified Authentication.

New products like that usually open more in-market enterprise accounts than the team can cover before the message lands everywhere it should. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Joon, quick follow-up for Prove.

With ProveX to push into enterprise, pipeline expectations tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many enterprise meetings Prove needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Joon, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's enterprise reply rate likely compares to other identity and fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Joon, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing is everything around a launch, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Prove either way.
